update.title: Renamed images with local vision models
update.summary: Created a batch command that asked a local Ollama vision model for short descriptive filenames and copied each result without altering the originals.

blocks.body:
## Turn image folders into searchable names

I built a command for batches of screenshots and images whose generated names carried no meaning. It sent each supported image to a selected local Ollama vision model, then converted the response into a short, filesystem-safe filename.
